description: Replaces tile A with tile B, optionally only in one layer and/or one rectangle. Comparison and writing happen on the tile index; the flip bits of every cell are kept. Writes the file only if there really is something to change.

dry_run.description: true = compute and report everything, but write nothing. Default: false.

from_gid.description: GID to replace. Compared on the tile index.

height.description: Height of the rectangle. Default: to the bottom edge.

keep_flags.description: true (default): every cell keeps its flip bits. false: the flip bits from to_gid apply.

layer.description: Name of the layer; inside groups also 'group/layer'. Alternatively use layer_id.

layer_id.description: Id of the layer. Unique, unlike the name. Alternatively use layer.

path.description: Path to ONE Tiled map file (.tmx or .tmj) — no directory, no wildcards. Please pass it absolute: a relative path is resolved against the working directory of the server process, and that is chosen by the MCP host, not by the project.

width.description: Width of the rectangle. Default: to the right edge.

x.description: Left edge of the rectangle. Default 0.

y.description: Top edge of the rectangle. Default 0.

name: replace_tiles
title: Replace tiles
